UPDATE t_channel_station_feedback SET contact_status='NOT_REQUESTED',source_phone_ciphertext=NULL, last_error_code='STATION_CONTACT_SOURCE_INVALID',last_error_summary='来源联系方式不可用，已忽略该字段',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND ingest_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_channel_station_feedback SET ingest_status=CASE WHEN contact_status='REVIEW_NEEDED' THEN 'REVIEW_NEEDED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, processing_stage=CASE WHEN contact_status='REVIEW_NEEDED' THEN 'CONTACT_OR_ATTACHMENT' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, contact_status=CASE WHEN contact_status IN ('NOT_PROVIDED','NOT_PROCESSED') THEN CASE WHEN #{identityStored}=TRUE THEN 'ENCRYPTED' ELSE 'NOT_PROVIDED' END ELSE contact_status END, source_phone_ciphertext=NULL,pending_photo_urls=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL, last_error_code=CASE WHEN #{unavailableAttachments}>0 THEN 'STATION_ATTACHMENT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' WHEN contact_status='REVIEW_NEEDED' THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END, last_error_summary=CASE WHEN #{unavailableAttachments}>0 THEN '来源历史图片已不可访问，未生成分析证据' WHEN contact_status='REVIEW_NEEDED' THEN last_error_summary ELSE NULL END, processed_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND ingest_status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_channel_station_feedback SET ingest_status=#{status},processing_stage='CONTACT_OR_ATTACHMENT', contact_status=CASE WHEN #{review}=TRUE THEN 'REVIEW_NEEDED' ELSE contact_status END,retry_count=#{retryCount}, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='RETRY_PENDING' THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},NOW(3)) ELSE NULL END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_summary=#{errorSummary},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND ingest_status='PROCESSING'
